question: Should ClickClack support author-visible editing of already-sent channel and thread messages?
rationale: The patch is supported by focused UI behavior coverage and uses an existing message PATCH path, but accepting editing changes the product’s message-history and moderation expectations rather than correcting a documented broken flow.

options.title: Sponsor author editing
options.body: Accept author-only editing as a ClickClack capability and proceed with normal maintainer review of this implementation.

options.title: Defer editing UX
options.body: Keep the server capability internal and defer the visible editing workflow until message-history policy and UX direction are defined.

recommendation.title: Sponsor author editing
recommendation.body: Accept author-only editing as a ClickClack capability and proceed with normal maintainer review of this implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The only concrete ownership evidence available in the hydrated review context is the contributor’s implementation and proof; a product owner should replace this routing after current-main history is checked.
